Non-delivery kinds yield empty sender but cannot enter this terminal path. Native malformed claims fail parsing before ACK, unchanged. Failed/no-sender remains in SQLite and the ACK error; it is not peek_parked or inbox --peek. No new producer of anonymous legitimate messages found.

If store fails, shared-build --then native tests did not run; run those separately. No mutation yet. Author M1 patch: /tmp/f275/M1-refused-ack-leaves-row-running.patch; summary verified.
